text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A to lock in gains, but a gain relative to my average cost is not by itself a reason to sell; I should base trades on my plan and current information.","Past price movements do not predict future returns, so I should avoid treating Stock A’s rise as evidence it will keep rising—or that other stocks will recover.","My dislike of realizing losses and satisfaction from realizing gains can distort decisions; I should set consistent position and rebalancing rules and apply them to winners and losers alike."]}
